Good question — we have quite a few illuminated models. Since you've been looking at the 12" Student Desktop Globe (Blue Ocean), the illuminated version in that same style is the Odessa 12-inch Illuminated Desk Globe, which lights up to reveal a terrain map underneath the political one. If you'd like something bigger as a centrepiece, the Statesman 20-inch Illuminated Blue Ocean Floor Globe is our flagship illuminated piece with a walnut stand.

Were you thinking of upgrading to an illuminated one, or just curious what's out there?
How much is the Odessa vs student desktop globe?

The Odessa 12-inch Illuminated Desk Globe is $152.00 CAD, and the Replogle 12" Student Desktop Globe (Blue Ocean) is $125.00 CAD. Since both are under $99... actually both are over $99 individually except — wait, let me be precise: each is priced above $99 on its own, so shipping is free on either one.

Would illumination be the deciding factor for you, or is there something else pulling you toward the Student globe?

We don't have a standing discount code, but there's a "Talk with Mia" banner at the top of the site — a short voice chat that earns you a one-time $35 off code, valid for 30 days. Otherwise, both the Odessa and the Student globe already ship free since each is over $99.

Is the price the main thing holding you back, or are you still weighing illuminated vs. not?
Yes the price is holding me back

That makes sense — the Student Desktop Globe is a great pick at $125, same 12" size and raised relief detail as the Odessa, just without the illumination. You won't be giving anything up on quality or accuracy. And remember, if you do the quick "Talk with Mia" voice chat, you can get $35 off which would bring either one down nicely.

Would that discount route help, or would you rather just go with the Student globe now?

Great — look for the "Talk with Mia, get $35 off" banner at the top of the site. It's about a 20-minute voice conversation, and you'll get a single-use $35 off code valid for 30 days that you can then use on the Student Desktop Globe or the Odessa.

Once you have the code, you can add the Replogle 12" Student Desktop Globe - Blue Ocean with Raised Relief to your cart from its product page and apply it at checkout. Anything else I can help you weigh before then?
